page.overview:
Who is Camil Bensò?

Camil Bensò, is a Bretonnian count and a Knight of the Realm, the ruler of the village of Cavour in the Grand-Duchy of Savoie, a small fief of Carcassonne.

Bensò is one of the loyal knights in service to the grand-duchy.

Camil Bensò character is a tribute to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camillo_Benso,_Count_of_Cavour Camillo Benso, Count of Cavour], an Italian politician, businessman, economist and noble, and a leading figure in the movement towards Italian unification in the mid-ninettenth century.
